explication: SukiSU Ultra is an Android kernel-based root solution with a companion manager app and userspace daemon. The principal user workflow is managing root access and app profiles in the manager, which communicates with kernel functionality through the supercall interface; kernel policy and hooks enforce the resulting behavior. The README also identifies KPM, susfs management, and support across GKI and non-GKI kernels. Several manager and daemon implementation links are not visible in the excerpts, so those connections are omitted or marked unverified.
